verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is open source with no forced API keys or paywalls, and it outputs scraped data in portable formats such as Markdown (CLI `-o markdown`) and schema-defined structured JSON. Together these keep scraped data free of lock-in. However, nothing in the evidence shows a feature for exporting or importing job or crawl configurations to migrate them to another provider. missing for 10: documented export of job/crawl configurations in a portable format, explicit migration or data-export documentation, independent corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in

citations.quote: Open Source: No forced API keys, no paywalls—everyone can access their data.
Define custom schemas for extracting structured JSON from repetitive patterns.
